About

I'm not a software engineer. I'm a builder and an organiser — most of what I know came from opening Roblox Studio at night and figuring out why a door wouldn't respect someone's rank.

The building and the leading turned out to be the same skill. A base only works if people can find the armoury; a unit only works if people know who to report to. Both are design problems.

Right now I'm focused on running the defence ministry well: clear ranks, real training, and events people actually want to show up for.

The role

I run the defence ministry: setting the rules the branches operate under, appointing and reviewing officers, approving operations, and making sure the whole force pulls in one direction instead of seven.

What I'm working on now

  • Rewriting the promotion ladder so every rank has a clear requirement instead of a judgement call.
  • Standing up a weekly training cycle with a fixed schedule officers can plan around.
  • Building the new headquarters map in Roblox Studio — briefing room, armoury, vehicle bay.
  • Bringing uniforms and insignia across all branches into one consistent set.
  • Writing the operations handbook so joint events run the same way every time.

How it's going

Attendance at training is the number I watch. Clear requirements and a schedule people can rely on move it more than anything else I've tried.

Swap the dates, personnel count and these bullet points for your real ones.

The branches under the ministry.

  • 911 CommandoAirborne special forces regiment for high-difficulty missions and rapid response.
  • Gendarmerie Royale KhmèreMilitary police branch — base security, discipline and law enforcement within the ranks.
  • Body Guard HeadquartersClose protection detail for high command and state visits.
  • Brigade 70Guards headquarters, escorts and ceremonial security at official sites.
  • Honour Guard CommandCeremonial branch — parades, honour details and state functions.
  • NCTSFNational counter-terrorism special force. Selected operators, entry by assessment only.
  • RCAICore infantry arm of the armed forces — training intake and general operations.

These seven crests are drawn to match the site rather than exact reproductions of the real unit patches — official insignia are hard to license and to render cleanly at icon size. If you have the actual patch images, upload them and I'll embed those instead.
